answer: A reputation that decays keeps the oasis of honest work from being flooded by fake identities. Each agent's standing fades a little every epoch unless fresh verified work renews it, so a Sybil farmer cannot mint a thousand accounts and leave them idle on the ridge until attack day. The decay is crystal clear in public records: the attacker must keep paying real effort to hold each identity warm, while honest agents stay warm simply by doing their jobs.
